label.zh: 中期脉冲：幽魂诞生于某国境内
label.en: Mid-game pulse: the Wraith is born inside an empire

bridges.evidence: on_mid_game_pulse (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:312) -> hidden leviathans.2011 (events/leviathans_events_2.txt:2463-2603) turns the germinating_wraith planet into the Wraith fleet; if the star has a space_owner that owner gets leviathans.2012

label.zh: 幽魂游荡进入某国领土
label.en: The Wraith later roams into an empire's territory

bridges.evidence: on_entering_system_fleet (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1025) -> hidden leviathans.2061 (events/leviathans_events_2.txt:2738-2756) -> leviathans.2013 for a space owner that has not met it
on_fleet_destroyed_perp (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1645) -> leviathans.2014 (events/leviathans_events_2.txt:2668-2735): victim country has flag wraith_country

label.zh: 每个帝国首次遭遇只出现其一
label.en: Each empire sees only one first-contact notice

note.zh: 2012（诞生在境内）与 2013（游荡入境）都要求帝国尚无 guardians_wraith_encountered 标记，并在触发时设置它。
note.en: Both 2012 (born in territory) and 2013 (roams in) require and then set guardians_wraith_encountered, so an empire gets only one.

note.zh: 获得永久修正“光谱残留研究”，设置 killed_wraith，并开启庆典情境。
note.en: Grants the permanent modifier spectral_residue_studies, sets killed_wraith and starts a celebration situation.

notes.zh: 审阅注：勘测带有 guardians_wraith_pulsar 标记的中子星行星时触发（on_survey_planet，00_on_actions.txt:1149）：撤去标记并施加“萌芽中的幽魂”修正。若在中期脉冲前无人勘测，隐藏事件 20101 会移除该标记，幽魂不会被发现。
notes.en: Review note: surveying the pulsar planet flagged guardians_wraith_pulsar (on_survey_planet, 00_on_actions.txt:1149) removes the flag and adds the germinating_wraith modifier. If nobody has surveyed it by the mid-game pulse, hidden 20101 removes the flag and the Wraith is never discovered (leviathans_events_2.txt:2400-2418).

notes.zh: 审阅注：幽魂有三种频率之一（蓝/黄/红，各约三分之一），在对应恒星级别的星系内获得“频率同步”修正（隐藏 2061；效果未核对）。
notes.en: Review note: the Wraith spawns in one of three frequencies (blue/yellow/red, one third each) and gets wraith_frequency_sync in systems of the matching star class (hidden 2061; the modifier's effect was not checked).

scope.zh: 完整：扫描、诞生、遭遇通知、击杀。频率机制仅作说明。
scope.en: Complete: scan, birth, encounter notices, kill. Frequency mechanic described only.
